case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Your offer speaks of continuing our relationship, and that is what Option A is built for: a binding volume that gives your plant steady load over a long contract term.

Option A is the package we can approve. It brings your plant business on top of what you supply us today, and it secures that volume for the whole term.

On the price outlook:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our order history with you:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.17; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since price questions may need a decision beyond your desk, please take Option A to the person who decides on your side. It is one clear step for both family companies, and we would be glad to see it through with you.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the binding volume of 30,000 units per year over a 36-month term and acknowledge the historical price stability of the individual components.

Our offer is a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To provide you with a more competitive price, we have based our counter-offer on Option B with a 45-day payment term. We can offer €5.54 per unit for this package, reflecting the value of your long-term commitment. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.54 per unit, with a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You write that you appreciate the binding volume and the long term, and that is exactly what Option A secures for your plant: steady load on top of what you supply us today, for the whole contract term.

Thank you for confirming that the volume data holds. On the price history, we would simply put one more example next to it:

Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.22; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.26; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant the full binding volume and a long contract in one step, at a price that lets us commit for the entire term.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since price changes may need sign-off on your side, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides there. For that person, it is simple: a binding volume for the whole term, business on top of today's supply, and steady use of your plant's capacity from a partner who stays with you.

We would like this to be a fair solution for both of our companies, and we hope Option A gets us there.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
